qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global toll booth and high switching costs in cross-border air/ocean freight forwarding and customs brokerage. Intermediates cargo capacity between shippers and carriers across 100+ countries, maintaining net revenue margins across freight cycles. Customs clearance involves deep enterprise ERP integrations and regulatory compliance with near-zero customer churn. High ROIC (>60-70% 10-year median) proves strong moat; primary risks are carrier disintermediation and geopolitical trade contractions.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier non-asset-based global freight forwarder and customs broker with an entrenched toll-booth moat, zero debt, >70% operating ROIC, and legendary decentralized profit-sharing culture. Insulated from energy transition and benefits from supply chain complexity. [5-10Y g: global trade volume 2.5% + customs brokerage share 1.5% + net revenue yield management 1.0% + net share repurchases 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 79.1% and operating ROIC of 79.7%, driven by an asset-light model with capex under 0.5% of revenues. FCF conversion averages 101.6% of Net Income. Balance sheet carries zero long-term debt and $1.31B in cash. Normalized Owner EPS has compounded from $3.51 in 2018 to $5.97 in 2025, demonstrating secular peak-to-peak earnings growth through freight cycles.
